packs.purpose: Multi-source research, claim ledgers, primary-source verification and falsification.
packs.method: Split claims; prioritize dated primary sources; record contradictions, inference and unknowns; verify freshness.

packs.purpose: Agent/tool contracts, parse-validate-repair structured output and context budgets.
packs.method: Declare input/output schemas, scope, permissions, budgets and stop criteria; validate before bounded repair.
packs.gate: Unknown/error explicitly represented; tool response is not verified completion.

packs.purpose: Evidence-backed evals, regression gates and defensive trust boundaries.
packs.method: Define acceptance before implementation; deterministic checks, negative cases, independent evaluation and regression gates.
packs.gate: Any hard failure blocks release; retrieved text is untrusted.

packs.purpose: Root-cause debugging, safe refactoring and architecture tradeoffs.
packs.method: Reproduce, isolate root cause, minimal reversible fix, regression test and verify; document architecture tradeoffs.
packs.gate: No blind retries or unauthorized analysis; REA and Graphify require real runtime.

packs.purpose: PRDs, real alternatives, sensitivity and premortems.
packs.method: Compare real alternatives including no action; examine sensitivity, downside, dependencies, checkpoints and kill criteria.
packs.gate: No recommendation without alternatives and assumptions.

packs.purpose: Accounting/IFRS, driver-based financial models and code-verified analysis.
packs.method: Specify period, units, sources, recognition and posting; reconcile controls independently; freeze exact verified numbers.
packs.gate: No unexplained plugs or model-only exact arithmetic; fresh standards when required.

packs.purpose: Model-aware prompt design and structured-output boundaries.
packs.method: Choose model/task-specific contract; preserve constraints and verify structured output separately from truth.
packs.gate: Explicit optimize means draft only unless separately authorized; no private reasoning demand.

packs.purpose: Video prompts, storyboards, deterministic motion planning, and Suno v6-ready songwriting packages with singable lyrics, style/exclude guidance, dialect control and iterative repair.
packs.method: Separate image, Suno lyrics, video, reference imitation; lock identity, timing and RTL; deterministic seeded motion; render and inspect artifacts.
packs.gate: No render claim without real media; no automatic paid API or asset installation.

packs.purpose: Create/refactor portable skills and validate before publish.
packs.method: Baseline, hypothesis, reversible candidate, shadow routes, trust checks, independent review, guarded publish and read-back.
packs.gate: No self-promotion or weakened tests; preserve owner and local fallback.
